donordrive.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is watching your DonorDrive (charity) page right now.
donordrive.isConnected.returns: true while Cuebot is checking your participant or team page, otherwise false.

donordrive.sendTestEvent.description: Fakes a DonorDrive event inside Cuebot, so you can test your triggers. Nothing is sent to DonorDrive and it works without a connection.

parameters.kind: Optional. Which event: "donation", "incentive" (a donation that picked a reward) or "profile" (your totals went up). Default "donation".

donordrive.sendTestEvent.returns: true when the test event was sent, false when the kind is unknown.

donordrive.getProfile.description: Gives you the last details Cuebot read from your DonorDrive page, like your goal and how much you raised.
donordrive.getProfile.returns: id, name, teamName, eventName, goal, raised, donations (how many), isTeam (true/false) and url. null when nothing was read yet.
